services.source: Full 52-item service menu with exact names, prices and durations resolved directly from Booksy's live internal __NUXT_DATA__ payload (devalue-format JSON) embedded in the business page, fetched and parsed in Python 2026-07-19 (regex-matched all {id, promotion, type, duration, price} variant objects and resolved each field's index reference against the flat data array). Prices cross-checked and 100% matched against the public JSON-LD makesOffer list (52 offers) on the same page, confirming correct parsing. Durations are not present in JSON-LD and were sourced only from the resolved NUXT payload. 3 near-duplicate entries (a second 'Brow Tint' $40 at a different duration, a second 'Brow Class One On One' $400 at a different duration, and a duplicate-worded brow enhancement service at the same $30 price) were consolidated to their first-listed variant for site display; all 52 raw entries are preserved below for the record.

brand_vibe.description: No dedicated brand/interior photography exists (no professional studio shoot, no vector logo; Booksy's 'logo' field for this business is actually a photo of Starr performing a facial treatment in a branded grey scrub reading 'Starr Mckinney Licensed Aesthetician' with a small hand-drawn 'Face to Face Esthetics' line-art mark of two profiles kissing). Real client photography (Booksy review photos and service photos) shows warm skin tones, bold feminine styling (colorful wigs, glam makeup, jewelry) consistent with the Instagram bio's own hashtags (#Melanin, #BrowBoss, #BrowBabe, #Brow-Ti-Ful). A warm, light, quiet-luxury base in the spirit of the Amani exemplar fits best, tinted toward a terracotta/rosewood accent (rather than Amani's mocha, Alea's gold, or allaboutdetails' kelly green) to read as warm, feminine and beauty-forward without copying an existing palette.
brand_vibe.palette_name: browbabes (terracotta/rosewood on warm ivory, new palette, does not reuse mizu/amani/mare/alea/pausa/allaboutdetails/betynails)

images_downloaded.source: Instagram feed (via web_profile_info, 12 posts + expanded GraphSidecar carousels) was reviewed in full but rejected as the gallery source: all content is Starr's personal/lifestyle photography (graduation, family, birthday selfies), not treatment or result photos, per the pipeline's visual-curation rule. Per pipeline fallback, Booksy's own photo set was used instead: 1 business cover photo, 1 'logo'-field photo (actually a service-in-progress photo), 4 service_photos, and 20 review_photos attached to verified Booksy reviews (fetched at full resolution by dropping the '?size=100x100' query parameter Booksy serves by default). All 26 files verified with `file` as valid JPEGs, all well over 15KB, none corrupt.
images_downloaded.curation_note: Every downloaded photo was visually reviewed (Read/vision) one by one before selecting the 10 used on the site (1 hero + 2 experience + 7 gallery, with 1 image reused between experience and gallery). Excluded from gallery per the quality gate: 4 photos with visible eyes-closed mid-procedure or under a facial mask (service-4.jpg ear lavage close-up, review-06/09/13/19/20 filter or eyes-closed shots); 5 photos with text/sticker overlays burned into the image (review-02 'Dec.16' heart sticker, review-17/18 camera timestamp overlays, review-19 '#nofilter' sticker); 1 distorted/fisheye funny-face shot (review-06); 1 exact duplicate file (review-14 identical to review-04); the owner's own car selfie (biz-cover.jpg / 'image' field) was kept only as a small avatar in the Experience section, never as a gallery tile, per the rule that owner selfies are avatar-only.
used_in_site: hero-1.jpg (from Booksy service_photos, 4-panel close-up of two brow/lash results, eyes open, sharp focus): HERO image and first (wide) gallery tile.
experience-1-treatment.jpg (from Booksy's 'logo' field, a real photo of Starr Mckinney applying a facial mask in a branded scrub): Experience section, process/ambiance shot.
owner-starr.jpg (from Booksy's 'image'/cover field, a car selfie of Starr): small round avatar in the Experience section only, never used as a gallery tile.
gallery-2-browtint.jpg (from Booksy service_photos, side-by-side before/after brow tint comparison, eyes open): Experience section second photo and gallery tile.

gallery-3-client.jpg / gallery-4-client.jpg / gallery-5-client.jpg / gallery-6-client.jpg / gallery-7-client.jpg (from Booksy review_photos attached to verified 5-star reviews): real clients showing finished brow tint results, eyes open, smiling, natural lighting, no text overlays: gallery tiles.
images_downloaded.resize_note: All images used on the site were resized to a maximum width of 1000px (Pillow, LANCZOS resampling, JPEG quality 82, optimize=True) before use, per the pipeline's mandatory performance rule; portrait images narrower than 1000px were kept at original width and just re-encoded/optimized.
